review_mode: Static source/hash/AST only; no candidate imports, qualifier, model or optimizer execution. RUN_ONCE absent.

reuse.constructor_and_close_review: Same lock flags/name/inode and descriptor cleanup. New before_release callback executes inside gate before fd removal; pending refusal leaves fd/lease/session intact.

lifecycle_review: create/load acquire lease before factory or checkpoint read/restore; constructor errors close descriptor after operation context releases gate.
SessionWriter wraps prepare/commit/abort/advance/read/save operations; root lease retained throughout writer lifetime and between prepare and commit/abort. No per-method unlock.
Close invokes pending check inside lease gate and cannot relinquish a pending candidate. Context exit intentionally does not autoabort; caller must settle pending or process must exit.

Simple lowercase root-local JSON basename rejects parent/absolute paths; load rejects symlink, save retains underlying atomic nooverwrite/filefsync. Stable trusted root and no hostile replacement required.
Raw ExplicitSession/Pending/backend access is not a security sandbox. Same-root cooperative delivery wrapper shares identical flock inode, while other roots/old snapshots are not globally ordered.
count_basis: Two prepare calls each allocate restored candidate and one Adam update; first commits/saves, second remains pending and is killed. Recovery allocates from committed checkpoint without objective/update. Model factory runs once plus one intentionally failing factory without model. Actual allocation count partly source-derived, not a newly instrumented global counter.
chronology: Own holder READY binds PID/freeze, first checkpoint bytes/hash/payload cursor1/update1, separate pending update2 evidence. Independent contender overlaps holder then fully reaped; own still-unreaped holder kill/reap; independent recovery. Handled exceptions reap active own PIDs. Supervisor hardkill cleanup not guaranteed.
recovery_and_accounting: Recovery only caller-selected first committed snapshot; replay committed token and wrong cursor refused before new objective. Pending candidate discarded but full holder CPU and separate candidate evidence retained; no free/refunded work. No latest-head pointer or global token ledger, and discarded token not persisted into recovered checkpoint. External callback effects never claimed exactly-once.

resources.scope: Complete outer wait4 includes workers once plus full supervisor, including killed work; outer prefix/unknown final tail and source/review/history additional. Concurrent RSS not sum.

limitations: Only tiny known synthetic objective, not scientific dataset/research benefit/full model training qualification.
Exceptions/BaseException arbitrary callback effects, all abort paths, all crash timings, fork descriptor lifetime, machine/powerloss/directory fsync not newly tested.
Cooperating trusted local root only, no malicious-code isolation/distributed locks/owner authority.
Old V3/source reviews and prior attachment provenance correction unchanged; platform/data/science holds preserved.
execution_authorization: Source pass only; parent once-only admission needed before run.
